patch.text: REVIEW: (a) printed paraṃ may be a typo for paraḥ (subject of kopayiṣyati); no text_flag could be added. (b) In "mitram aparuddhaṃ vā-asya" and "mitram āśrayaṃ vā-asya" vā may link two objects ("an ally or an aparuddha / an ally or a support"); the rendering "shut-out ally" is literal and unsettled.
